question: Point out the correct answer regarding B lymphocytes.

options.opa: Its two main subpopulations are called B-helper and B-cytotoxic.
options.opb: They are the cells responsible for the production of antibodies in the rejection of an autologous transplant of hematopoietic progenitors.
options.opc: They are the target cells of the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody (rituximab).
options.opd: They require co-stimulation CD20-CD19 for the expression of the CD3 molecule on its surface.
options.ope: It is the type of majority lymphocyte in the peripheral blood of patients with Bruton's disease.
